figurative_meaning_bn: উন্নতির পথে অগ্রসর হতে সাহায্য করা
figurative_meaning_en: To help someone advance or progress forward
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার বাবা তাকে চাকরিতে এগিয়ে দিয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His father gave him a push in his career.
The teacher helped the student advance in studies.
note: This idiom reflects everyday motivational language in Bengali culture.
